name: AI prompt improver for X — conditional kill unless the X workflow is redesigned and verified
demand: No reliable monthly search-volume figure was verified. Adjacent category evidence: Chrome Web Store lists Prompt Genie at 20,000 users and 304 ratings; this is a general prompt tool, not proof of demand for X lead generation (https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/prompt-genie-create-optim/inafdkdkghgibhijaplaobmomoahefin?hl=en-US). X reported 64.7 million average monthly active recipients in the EU for H1 2026, according to an independent mirror of its DSA filing; that is platform reach, not the addressable buyer count (https://socialmediatransparency.org/platform/x). Acquire’s seller page claims 10–50 customers, but provides no dated customer or payment records accessible here (https://app.acquire.com/public/alz97fhzlw-profitable-ai-saas-for-x-1-8k-revenue-zero-ads-92-margin-zero-ai-costs-byok). No relevant sector-regulated population was identified; PECR is a constraint on outreach channels, not a measure of product demand.
prices: Seller asks $5,000 and claims an $80–100 lifetime-deal AOV; both are unverified listing claims. Seller’s proposed $19–39/month subscription is a growth idea, not demonstrated current pricing (https://app.acquire.com/public/alz97fhzlw-profitable-ai-saas-for-x-1-8k-revenue-zero-ads-92-margin-zero-ai-costs-byok). Direct X lead-generation competitor XScout offers free, $4.49/month and $9.90/month plans (https://www.xscout.app/). Xpert lists $49/month Pro, $49/month promotional Growth normally $99, and $199/month Scale (https://xpert.so/pricing). Fireply lists $69, $99 and $129/month plans (https://fireply.ai/). Adjacent prompt improvers include free/open-source PromptPerfect (https://promptperfect.beaglecorp.com/), Prompt God at $25 lifetime after a free tier (https://promptgod.tech/), and PromptWick at £5.49 or £7.99/month plus VAT, or £46 lifetime plus VAT (https://promptwick.com/).

revenue_proof.claim: Acquire’s cached listing claims $1.8k TTM gross revenue, $1.7k profit, $510 last-month revenue, $475 last-month profit, 10–50 customers, and shows one P&L document. These are seller-reported figures, not verified settlements; the displayed $12k ARR is not reconciled with the monthly revenue or stated lifetime-deal model. The public page currently returns 410 on direct fetch, so the supporting document could not be inspected.
revenue_proof.claim_event_date: unverified — the listing says first 3.5 months since launch and founded April 2026, but gives no exact sales period, month for last-month revenue, or dated underlying transaction

copy_speed: High for generic prompt rewriting; fast for adjacent X engagement workflows. Fireply launched June 15, 2026 on Smol Launch and offers automated X replies (https://smollaunch.com/products/fireply; https://fireply.ai/). PrompTessor launched June 16, 2026 as a prompt generator, optimizer and library (https://www.producthunt.com/products/promptessor). XScout currently sells the closest surfaced lead-capture and personalized-DM workflow, but I found no verified launch date for it (https://www.xscout.app/). These dates establish adjacent competition, not an exact-match launch count.
platform_risk: Critical. The listing describes an extension working inside X, profile-style scraping, keyword auto-replies, lead discovery and personalized DMs based on profiles, posts and chat history (https://app.acquire.com/public/alz97fhzlw-profitable-ai-saas-for-x-1-8k-revenue-zero-ads-92-margin-zero-ai-costs-byok). X’s automation rules, updated April 2026, prohibit non-API scripting of its website, unsolicited automated DMs, and keyword-search-only automated replies; AI-powered automated reply bots require prior written approval (https://help.x.com/en/rules-and-policies/x-automation?lang=browser). X’s terms also prohibit scraping through unpublished interfaces and facilitating violations (https://x.com/en/tos). The listing does not establish official API use or written approval. Separately, ICO guidance treats social-media DMs as electronic mail; marketing to individual subscribers, including sole traders, generally requires consent or the soft opt-in (https://ico.org.uk/for-organisations/direct-marketing-and-privacy-and-electronic-communications/business-to-business-marketing/; https://ico.org.uk/for-organisations/direct-marketing-and-privacy-and-electronic-communications/guide-to-pecr/electronic-and-telephone-marketing/electronic-mail-marketing/?q=gdpr).
defensible_asset: None demonstrated beyond code, customer claims, and a seller-described affiliate portal and preset library (https://app.acquire.com/public/alz97fhzlw-profitable-ai-saas-for-x-1-8k-revenue-zero-ads-92-margin-zero-ai-costs-byok). No proprietary UK data, validated rules engine, or meaningful switching costs are evidenced. A consent-first workflow based on user-provided, opted-in contacts could become an asset, but it is not established in the listing.
build_effort: Recreating the stated extension, dashboard, licensing, payments and affiliate portal looks like a substantial software build; the seller lists TypeScript/Next.js, Cloudflare Pages/Workers and a multi-browser extension (https://app.acquire.com/public/alz97fhzlw-profitable-ai-saas-for-x-1-8k-revenue-zero-ads-92-margin-zero-ai-costs-byok). For an acquired codebase, the major unknown is policy remediation and ongoing X integration maintenance. No repo audit or source gives a credible hour estimate. AI agents could handle routine documentation, support triage and monitoring, but neither >=50% automation nor <=5 owner hours/week is verified.
channel: Use product-led inbound: a searchable Chrome Web Store listing, SEO/free prompt tools, product-owned public posts, opt-in email, and affiliates or named distribution partners with documented consent practices. Do not depend on cold DMs, email, SMS or WhatsApp to individuals or sole traders: ICO guidance covers social DMs as electronic mail and requires consent or a valid soft opt-in for individual subscribers (https://ico.org.uk/for-organisations/direct-marketing-and-privacy-and-electronic-communications/business-to-business-marketing/; https://ico.org.uk/for-organisations/direct-marketing-and-privacy-and-electronic-communications/guide-to-pecr/electronic-and-telephone-marketing/electronic-mail-marketing/?q=gdpr). The seller’s claimed distribution partnership is unnamed and unverified (https://app.acquire.com/public/alz97fhzlw-profitable-ai-saas-for-x-1-8k-revenue-zero-ads-92-margin-zero-ai-costs-byok).
owner_hours_per_week: Seller claims less than 2 hours/week for routine maintenance and support; no activity logs or support records verify it. Actual owner hours are unverified (https://app.acquire.com/public/alz97fhzlw-profitable-ai-saas-for-x-1-8k-revenue-zero-ads-92-margin-zero-ai-costs-byok).
automation_share_pct: unverified — the listing says virtually automated but gives no measured automation share
desk_test: Zero-build, one-workday test: make a product-branded mock landing page for a human-reviewed, X-policy-compliant workflow, with no founder face and a transparent price test. Share it only in communities that permit promotion and through a product-owned public account; capture opt-in signups and explicit willingness-to-pay signals, with no cold messaging. Precommit the pass threshold before posting. In parallel, request dated payment-processor exports, the underlying P&L, the named partner agreement, and written evidence of X API access/approval; do not value those claims until verified.
red_flags: Current evidence does not establish the hard constraints: seller hours are unverified and automation share is unquantified. The feature set appears to depend on X interactions that conflict with published rules unless the seller can document approved API-based operation and required written approval. The revenue and customer figures are seller claims with no dated payment evidence; ARR is unreconciled; the distribution partner is unnamed; and the product’s DM workflow risks enabling outreach that violates X rules and UK PECR. Treat as no-go in its current form; reconsider only after a compliant redesign and documentary verification.
